name: flower_v1
doc: A clump of flowers (design/systems.md, Mushrooms and flowers): the game asks for a species and a season at a position with the local wind; grow makes the clump, in flower, in bud, or gone to seed, and the animator sways it in the same wind as the trees. Ground cover: no conformance, purely visual.

params.name: species
params.doc: A species: one genome from config/flower_v1_genomes/.

params.name: seed
params.doc: Which of the distinct clumps per species and season (the runtime caps how many by quality).

params.name: detail
params.doc: Level of detail; the runtime picks it from distance and quality.

params.name: wind_heading
params.doc: Toward which the wind blows, from +Z toward +X.
